research_rationale:
Identity: the registered original is the Federal Register text of Executive Order 13075 (63 FR 9085, PDF pages 1-2 of the 1998-02-24 issue; sha256 5137548d...), headed Executive Order 13075 of February 19, 1998, Special Oversight Board for Department of Defense Investigations of Gulf War Chemical and Biological Incidents, matching the census register row (1998-02-19). Text and inventory: thirteen scopes cover sections 1 through 4(c) to the signature; I confirm the inventory. All clauses belong to one advisory board. Ending: Executive Order 13225 section 3(e) revokes Executive Order 13075, effective September 30, 2001 (section 5). The report deadlines in section 2(e) and the report-relative termination in section 4(b) are not ends (owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on report deadlines). Original grade: Federal Register machine text.
